items.title: James Moody interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: mainly because of Chuck Mangione and the people up there like that

ctx.x: It could help with that. Jazz has become quite an institution in schools now so there’s a lot of places you can go for that. © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-

Well I’ll tell you Monk, now maybe up where you’re from, mainly because of Chuck Mangione and the people up there like that, and his brother Gap and Nick Brignola and the guys — who was the tenor player from up there, he’s a good buddy of mine.
